title: Birth in 1898 and starting clarinet
summary: Purnell gives his birth: March 1898 in New Orleans, after remarking his life was hell before he was crippled. He cannot recall his starting age; he began on clarinet, his brother played piano, he studied with an old Frenchman, and switched to saxophone at the other players' urging.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth
